milestones.title: Job search and resume tailoring foundation
notes: Built profile ingestion, job discovery, fit scoring, resume tailoring, review, and PDF rendering around provenance-backed facts.
Added the web workspace, job tracking, ATS connectors, skill taxonomy, Match & Gap, and profile coaching.
Covers the entire initial history from the first scaffold on June 8 through the last June commit.

milestones.title: Accounts, career workflows, and provider controls
notes: Expanded profile synthesis and source management, Career Lab, interview preparation, and discovery workflows.
Added authentication, email verification, OAuth, tenancy controls, and spending quotas.
Improved agent streaming, review behavior, and the web application experience.

milestones.title: Evidence, company intelligence, and application timelines
notes: Strengthened fact-lock review and evidence portfolio tailoring, skill taxonomy maintenance, and security boundaries.
Added grounded company intelligence, hiring contact research, role preparation, role comparison, and saved workspace views.
Added application timelines, calendar exports and reminders, funnel analytics, and English/Chinese interface localization.
Established dev integration and protected main promotion workflows.

milestones.title: Provider routing and workflow hardening
notes: Expanded model support and unified provider routing, structured output handling, and conversation behavior.
Added evidence-bearing public job URL imports, browser-free acquisition and recovery, and persistent scrape review workflows.
Completed the subscription credit lifecycle, added dashboard operation history, and improved timezone handling and Gmail resilience.
Covers all September changes including the Responses routing hotfix.

milestones.title: Interactive applications, Gmail recovery, and grouped settings
notes: Added interactive job application SDK workflows, reusable screening answers, and structured application profiles.
Added resumable incremental Gmail sync, cached recruiting decision review, email digests, and notification preferences.
Grouped settings by user workflow and expanded Chinese localization, model support, and evidence-grounded agent policies.
Strengthened typing, offline regression coverage, and dependency security audits. The target main commit passed its full CI push run.
